newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PLANS BOND ISSUE, KOMERCNI LEAD.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PLANS BOND ISSUE, KOMERCNI LEAD.

text.p: The Czech state-owned Konsolidacni Banka a.s. said on Wednesday that it planned a domestic bond issued lead-managed by Prague-based Komercni Banka probably in April.
"It will be most likely in April," Mario Zubrik, who manages primary issues for the state's debt factoring bank, told Reuters.
He said details on the bond's conditions could come later this week or next week. A Komercni official involved in the issue declined comment on the bond's details.

Banking sources said the market is expecting a major issue from Konsolidacni alongside the bank's multi-billion crown programme to support the buyout of non-performing debt at several small private Czech banks.
The Prague office of Citibank said in a recent newsletter to investors that a Konsolicani issue was expected to have a maturity of seven years, on an issue totalling seven billion crowns.
The Czech Republic's sovereign debt carries a Standard & Poor's investment-grade rating of "A".
